特别处档案室。
档案号 Y. O. 940。

主题

关于从希姆莱（Himmler）处收到的有关德国人的情报的报告。

相关人名：
尼尔森（Nielsen）
汉斯·费尔克尔（Hans Voelkel）及施罗德（Schroeders）。

19th. March 1917
REPORT ON The Watch on the premises of Hoelkel + Schroeder's
No 83 Ward Road
Made by D.S. Knight Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir.
I beg to report that the watch on
the above mentioned premises have been continued
since my last report on the 10th inst. but nothing
important occurred, On the morning of the 17th
2 Wheelbarrows each containing two boxes were despatched
to No 37 Nanking Road, To-day a Handcart loaded
with 4 Boxes was taken into the above mentioned
premises, while two Wheelbarrow loads was despatched
to No 37 Nanking Road.
I am Sir.
Yours Obediently
J Knight
Det Sgt N o 95

1917年3月19日
关于对华德路83号费尔克尔与施罗德（Hoelkel + Schroeder） premises 的监视报告
由警佐奈特（D.S. Knight）制作，经首席探长转呈。
先生。
谨此报告，自本月10日我上次报告以来，对上述处所的监视一直在持续，但未发生重要情况。17日上午，两辆独轮车每辆装载两个箱子，被运往南京路37号。今日，一辆装有4个箱子的手推车被带入上述处所，同时有两独轮车的货物被运往南京路37号。
此致
敬礼
J·奈特
第95号警佐

pages.en:
February 23,

Sir Everard D.H. Fraser, K.C.M.G.,
H.E.M.'s Consul-General,
Shanghai.
My dear Sir Everard, Confidential
With reference to my letter to
you of February 20, I have to inform you that
Detective Sub-Inspector Cruickshank reports that
he met Kindler again at about 7-30 p.m. on
February 22 on the Broadway not far from his
residence.
Kindler repeated the story which he gave on a
former date, and added that the Germans are busily
manufacturing bombs, shells and high explosives
at the godown of Voelkel & Schroeder, 83 Ward Road.
The Detective Sub-Inspector saw an official
of the German Consulate in the vicinity of Kindler's
house before the conversation took place, and he
believes that he was there for the purpose of
watching Kindler.
I am having Voelkel & Schroeder's godown watched
and will let you know the result.
I do not attach a very great deal of importance
to this report, although I feel bound to investigate
it.
Yours sincerely,
Captain-Superintendent of Police.
（批：CDJ）
pages.zh:
2月23日，

埃弗拉德·D.H. 弗雷泽爵士（Sir Everard D.H. Fraser），K.C.M.G.，
英王陛下驻上海总领事，
上海。
亲爱的埃弗拉德爵士，机密
参照我于2月20日给您的信件，特此告知，副探长克鲁克香克（Cruickshank）报告称，他于2月22日晚上约7点30分，在百老汇路（Broadway）距其住所不远处再次遇见了金德勒（Kindler）。
金德勒重复了他此前讲述的故事，并补充说，德国人正在华德路83号费尔克尔与施罗德（Voelkel & Schroeder）的仓库里忙碌地制造炸弹、炮弹和高爆炸药。
在谈话发生之前，副探长在金德勒住所附近看到了一名德国领事馆官员，他认为该官员在那里是为了监视金德勒。
我已安排对费尔克尔与施罗德的仓库进行监视，并将把结果告知您。
虽然我觉得有必要对此进行调查，但我对该报告的重要性并不十分看重。
您真诚的，
警务处处长兼警司。
（批注：CDJ）

Sir,
Detective Sub Inspector Cruickshank reports that
he met Kindler again at about 7.30 p.m. on February
22nd on the Broadway Road not far from his residence.
Kindler repeated the story which he gave(and of
which a report was made)on a former date and added
that the Germans were now busily manufacturing
bombs, shells and high explosives at the godown
of Messrs Voelkel & Schroder No.83 Ward Road.
The Detective Sub Inspector saw an official of
the German Consulate in the vicinity of Kindler's
house before the conversation took place and he
believes that he was there for the purpose of
watching Kindler.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Cummings
Chief Detective Inspector.

A.H.

My dear McEwen,

Many thanks for the report which

I doubt his story as the enemy

亲爱的麦克尤恩（McEwen），

非常感谢这份报告，我在抄录一份后将其退回。

K. 前一段时间来见我，希望受雇于我们。然而，我们的人对他过于不信任。他说自己经济非常拮据，愿意为任何雇主服务。
我怀疑他的故事，因为敌人知道抵抗的最终结局是不可避免的；但这或许值得稍微调查一下。

Date 21/2/17
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
February 20th 1917.

Sir,
D.S.I.Cruickshank reports that he met Kindler at about 7 p.m. on Feby 19th who invited him to come into an alleyway off Hwakee Road where he told him a story to the following effect and declared with many oaths that it was absolutely correct and true.
He commenced informing the Detective Sub Inspector that he had been dismissed from the Austrian Volunteer Coy and had been prohibited from entering the German Club and continued by saying that a few days ago the Germans in Shanghai had held a meeting in the latter establishment where they decided to defend to the last all their concessions in China and all their property in Shanghai. Four places were mentioned as important. these were Peking, Tientsin, Hankow and Shanghai, and all Germans in these regions around had been warned to flock to the four centres within eight days of the time the warning was given.
He added that the German Volunteers and other Germans of military age were drilling daily at 5 p.m. in the grounds of the German Public School and that the officers had been selected who were to take charge of and carry out the plans formed in connection with the scheme of defence.
A box containing arms had been moved, he thought, from the German Consulate to the Club on the Bund and another similar box was lying in readiness at the Austrian Consulate.
The Germans and Austrians in Shanghai he estimated at three thousand. All valuables in offices and Banks had been removed to places of safety the whereabouts of which he did not know.
He also related the story of his arrest by the Austrian Consul and said it was caused by his having shadowed Nielsen to the Club from a wharf in Frenchtown where he received from a German Customs Officer named Bill Hanson a case containing arms of some description. When near the Club Nielson turned round suddenly and saw Kindler whom he denounced. The denunciation led

1917年2月20日。

先生，
副探长克鲁克香克（D.S.I. Cruickshank）报告称，他于2月19日晚上约7点遇见了金德勒（Kindler），金德勒邀请他进入虹口路（Hwakee Road）旁的一条小巷，并向他讲述了如下内容，且多次发誓称其绝对正确属实。
他开始向副探长透露，他已被奥地利志愿连开除，并被禁止进入德国总会，接着他说，几天前，在沪德国人在该会所举行了一次会议，决定在中国的所有租界以及在上海的所有财产都将防守到底。提到了四个重要地点，即北京、天津、汉口和上海，这些地区周围的所有德国人都已接到警告，要求在发出警告后的八天内聚集到这四个中心。
他补充说，德国志愿兵及其他适龄德国人每天下午5点在德国公学（German Public School）的场地上进行操练，并且已经选出了负责执行与防御计划相关的军官。
他认为，一箱武器已从德国领事馆移至外滩的德国总会，另一箱类似的武器也已在奥地利领事馆准备就绪。
他估计在沪的德国人和奥地利人有三千人。办公室和银行中的所有贵重物品已被转移到安全地点，但他不知道这些地点的具体位置。
他还讲述了自己被奥地利领事逮捕的经历，并称原因是他跟踪尼尔森（Nielsen）从法租界的一个码头前往总会，在那里尼尔森从一名名为比尔·汉森（Bill Hanson）的德国海关官员手中接收了一个装有某种武器的箱子。当接近总会时，尼尔森突然转身看见了金德勒，并对其进行了告发。这一告发导致
